theorem_dependency_review.2.1: General disjoint parameter spaces, hierarchical prior, variational family/posterior and negative ELBO. Individual argmins, weights and normalizer are defined inside the theorem; no Algorithm 1 premise.
theorem_dependency_review.3.1: Individual posterior plus A1 and A2; uniform over all true parameters and all individual models.
theorem_dependency_review.3.3: General KL bounds first; only the final gap-(3.1) conclusion assumes A2 and B3. Do not add A1 or B1/B2.
theorem_dependency_review.3.4: Adaptive posterior, oracle rate, all of A1/A2/B1/B2/B3 and the metric/true-model convention.
theorem_dependency_review.3.5: A2 and all B parts, n epsilon_n^2 diverging, and M_over; no A1.
theorem_dependency_review.3.6: All A/B parts and M_under. Underlined A_n is preserved. No example beta-min assumption is inserted.
theorem_dependency_review.4.1: Neural-network posterior instantiated with the actual uniform priors/family, architecture/parameter bounds, Gaussian regression likelihood, empirical L2 and sup norm. Its oracle rate is bound inside the statement. Neither Holder class nor Assumption C is required.
theorem_dependency_review.5.1: Combinatorial merged-model posterior and D1/D2/D3 for contraction and no-underestimation; only D2/D3 for the final no-severe-overestimation clause. Rate is (5.3), not the generic (3.5).
theorem_dependency_review.5.2: Sparse-factor Gaussian experiment, spike-and-slab prior/family, covariance truth class, operator norm and printed asymptotic/model-size conditions. No signal lower bound from (5.12).
theorem_dependency_review.5.3: Same model/prior/family and all assumptions of 5.2 plus signal-restricted truth class (5.12). Import source conditions rather than treating the conclusion of 5.2 as an extra premise.
theorem_dependency_review.6.1: A2/B1/B3 only, adaptive posterior, oracle rate and large-ivB-penalty set. No A1 or B2.
theorem_dependency_review.6.2: A1/A2/B1/B3, adaptive posterior, oracle rate and maximal sieve complexity. No B2 or ideal-penalty condition.
theorem_dependency_review.7.1: E1 for the displayed quasi-posterior gap bound, E2/E3 additionally for (7.5). Preserve Lambda_n without star in first clause and coefficient c_2/rho.
theorem_dependency_review.7.2: All E parts, variational quasi-posterior and oracle-rate formula. Do not import A/B testing or prior-tail assumptions.

source_issues_to_record: Equation (4.4) prints Unif(-psi_1,j,psi_2,j) but bounds -B_n<=psi_1,j<psi_2,j<=B_n; preserve this possible interval-sign inconsistency.
Equation (7.2) writes E_n(Q,Pi_n,m,p_n^natural) but its displayed KL term is KL(Q,Pi_n). Preserve both rather than silently fixing the prior subscript.
Assumption E is scoped to true parameters in Lambda_n^star, while Theorem 7.1 first quantifies over Lambda_n. Preserve and flag that scope discrepancy.
KL may be infinite and ivB uses differences of KL values; the source does not state conventions resolving every infinity-minus-infinity case.

The generic model space is countable, while simplex notation is introduced in finite dimensions. Preserve source notation and record unresolved infinite-mixture/normalizer or optimizer-selection cases.
The published main text contains supplementary references but all appendix bodies remain excluded.
